basic_info.description: Perched in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, this fully tenant-occupied 2-unit building offers an exceptional blend of comfortable living and income potential.    The upper unit is a light-filled 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home situated on a single level, featuring a private deck with sweeping views of the San Francisco skylineperfect for enjoying sunsets or city lights.    The lower unit is a well-designed 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence with equally impressive views, and exclusive access to the large backyard.  Plus the added convenience of a 2-car garage and shared laundry.    Both units are leased at market rents, making this a turn-key investment in a neighborhood known for its lively community atmosphere, easy access to local shops, restaurants, and parks.    A rare opportunity to own a view property with steady income in the heart of Bernal Heights!
